hens_rule_text: up to 7 urban domestic fowl allowed in residential districts, kept only for egg production, no roosters
permit_notes: No permit is required to keep chickens under Sec. 6-154, provided the coop, setback and fowl-count conditions are met.
setback_notes: Coop may not be within 25 ft of any dwelling or business building owned, used or maintained by anyone other than the owner or keeper.
coop_rules: Coop (hen house) must not exceed 5 ft wide by 5 ft long by 5 ft high, and must be surrounded by a 6 ft high secure fenced enclosure; fowl must stay in the enclosure at all times.
zoning_notes: Rule is citywide for residential districts under Chapter 6, Article VI, Sec. 6-154 'Keeping of any livestock or fowl', amended in 2011 to add the urban domestic fowl allowance. No profit may be made from egg sales.
hoa_note: Homeowners associations, deed restrictions and leases can be stricter than city law. Check yours before getting chickens.
